# ClawBox Documentation

> ClawBox is pre-configured AI hardware (NVIDIA Jetson) running OpenClaw OS — a self-hosted AI assistant reachable from Telegram and the web. This documentation covers consumer setup, deep technical reference, troubleshooting, and recovery. Site: https://docs.clawbox.com · Source: https://github.com/ID-Robots/clawbox (docs live in docs-site/, releases are vX.Y.Z tags on main, integration branch is beta).

Key facts: web UI at http://<box-ip> port 80 (never :18789 — that's the token-gated gateway; it loads but rejects passwords); a default-deny inbound firewall (ufw) ships on the device — only 22/tcp SSH, 80/tcp web UI, 443/tcp HTTPS when certs are installed, 18789/tcp gateway (nothing listens there on Hermes) and, on Hermes/dual, 8090/tcp are reachable, and only from private LAN ranges (plus 5353/udp mDNS from anywhere and the hotspot's own DHCP/DNS); 631 CUPS, 111 rpcbind and 3006 (the raw, unauthenticated terminal PTY — use /terminal-ws on port 80) are closed to the LAN; one Linux password (`clawbox` user) for both SSH and browser login; device state in /home/clawbox/clawbox/data and, per edition, ~/.openclaw or ~/.hermes (survives updates; wiped by factory reset, except data/network.env, data/llamacpp/models and ~/.hermes/hermes-agent); updates are git-tag based and reboot the box at the end; provider credentials live in ~/.openclaw/agents/main/agent/auth-profiles.json.

## Start Here

- [Quick Reference](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/quick-reference): the one-page fact sheet — ports, paths, services, commands, endpoints, gotchas. Best single page for agents.
- [ClawBox Overview](https://docs.clawbox.com/): what ClawBox is, models, pricing
- [Quickstart](https://docs.clawbox.com/quickstart): unbox → power → talk
- [What's New](https://docs.clawbox.com/whats-new): dated, customer-facing changes on the current release

## Setup

- [First Boot](https://docs.clawbox.com/setup/first-boot): unbox, join the ClawBox-Setup hotspot (open, 10.42.0.1 / fallback 10.43.0.1), run the 5-step browser wizard (Wi-Fi → update → password → AI provider → optional Telegram) — the first-run guide. There is NO QR-code pairing; the only QR in the product opens Telegram's @BotFather
- [Connect to a Network](https://docs.clawbox.com/setup/connect-network): joining Wi-Fi or Ethernet after setup
- [Choose Your AI Provider](https://docs.clawbox.com/setup/choose-ai-provider): ClawBox AI, Claude, GPT, Gemini, OpenRouter, local models — with an API-key tab AND a Subscription tab (Claude Pro/Max, ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Google One AI Premium OAuth); models a subscription does not cover are greyed out, not offered
- [OpenClaw Setup](https://docs.clawbox.com/setup/openclaw-setup): gateway configuration

## Editions

- [Editions](https://docs.clawbox.com/editions/overview): the three editions (openclaw | hermes | dual), chosen at flash time and recorded in the root-owned /etc/clawbox/edition.env; no `clawbox` command is installed — run `bun run /home/clawbox/clawbox/mcp/clawbox-cli.ts edition` to print it
- [Switching Editions](https://docs.clawbox.com/editions/switching): Settings → Harness re-makes a single-edition box as the other edition through the `harness_swap` root step — needs the Max plan, internet and ~3 GB free; carries the ClawBox AI sign-in, the Telegram bot token and Memory Shard's folders; Telegram approvals and other provider sign-ins are per harness. NOT the same as /setup-api/harness/select, which is the dual SKU's runtime switch. An update never changes the edition
- [Hermes Edition](https://docs.clawbox.com/editions/hermes): Hermes Agent as the only agent — no OpenClaw gateway (unit masked, :18789 closed, /api/* and /chat 404), no App Store or Control UI, Skills + Hermes dashboard instead; the CLI update path is refused on this edition, use Settings → System Update. ClawKeep backs up this edition too — the backup daemon archives the Hermes agent through its own backend, no openclaw CLI, and a snapshot only restores onto a box running the agent that wrote it. There is no VS Code / code-server app on ANY edition — it was removed from the product
- [AI Providers on Hermes](https://docs.clawbox.com/editions/hermes-providers): the Hermes models panel — sign-in vs API-key providers, ClawBox AI as a custom provider, on-device Gemma 4 with standby and a two-state Thinking off/on switch, eight reasoning levels for effort-scale providers (seven on ClawBox AI — no Ultra)
- [Hermes Skills](https://docs.clawbox.com/editions/hermes-skills): the capability store replacing the App Store; offline catalogue; install takes a full identifier, uninstall takes the short name; skills live in ~/.hermes/skills

## Technical Reference

- [System Architecture](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/architecture): service topology, request routing, boot lifecycle, and how the OS relates to its AI harness (OpenClaw on openclaw/dual, Hermes on hermes/dual)
- [Networking](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/networking): AP mode (no DNS hijack — dnsmasq forwards upstream; the middleware answers captive-portal probe paths), mDNS/clawbox.local reliability, full port map, remote access via /setup-api/portal/*, portal heartbeat
- [Filesystem Layout](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/filesystem): where everything lives; what survives updates vs factory reset; where secrets are
- [Authentication & Security](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/authentication): browser login flow (unix_chkpwd), session cookies, gateway token, service tokens
- [AI Providers](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/ai-providers): every provider lane, credential storage map, the two OpenAI lanes (both openai/, split by credential + Codex runtime), boot-time self-healing — OpenClaw/dual only; Hermes provider config is Hermes' own. Also the EVERY-EDITION parts: the ClawBox AI cloud-defaults matrix for tts/stt/embeddings (promote-only, never overwrites an owner's pick; reasons not_linked | plan | route_unavailable | owner (edition is the build-time kill switch and no shipping edition answers with it); the memory index reaches the cloud on EVERY edition, and the index client accepts only the loopback embedder proxy or this box's own ClawBox AI endpoint) and the plan gates (Memory Shard + Coding Agent = either paid tier, cloud TTS and the harness swap = Max)
- [Update System](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/update-system): tag-based updates, channels (main/beta), divergence/"Updates paused", manual-update pitfalls
- [Agent Interface (MCP)](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/agent-interface): the device tools the AI agent gets, the clawbox-cli.ts wrapper (invoked via bun; no `clawbox` command on PATH), auth model — the tool set differs by edition (app_* + coding family + coordinate browser control on OpenClaw only; skill_*, ai_* and memory_shard_search on Hermes only). Both editions also get email_send/list/read (send QUEUES a draft for the owner's approval while "Ask me before sending" is on, which is the default; with that switch off it sends directly), generate_image / generate_audio, memory_shard_status / local_ai_status / clawbox_ai_usage / anthropic_accounts (read-only: reindexing, engine installs, the plan and the Anthropic account list stay the owner's), the coding_agent_* / coding_run_* / coding_project_status / coding_team_* family

## Troubleshooting & Recovery

- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.clawbox.com/support/troubleshooting): symptom-first diagnostic ladders — can't reach the box, browser rejects password (SSH works), updates stuck, provider 401s, gateway token mismatch, Telegram
- [Recovery](https://docs.clawbox.com/support/recovery): ordered recovery options — password reset (sudo passwd clawbox), service restart, safe reinstall (hard-sync + install.sh), factory reset (password → clawbox, AP mode)
- [Forgot the Password](https://docs.clawbox.com/support/password-recovery): recovery with no password and no SSH — the password is always one of two candidates (wizard-set, or factory `clawbox` after a COMPLETED reset; a reset that failed partway leaves the wizard-set password in place), factory reset needs only a live session (not the password), and the one state that genuinely needs SSH
- [Updating ClawBox](https://docs.clawbox.com/support/updating): the supported update paths
- [FAQ](https://docs.clawbox.com/support/faq)

## Hardware

- [ClawBox](https://docs.clawbox.com/hardware/clawbox-connect): Jetson Orin Nano model; ships with Google Gemma 4 E2B (QAT Q4_0) preinstalled on llama.cpp, ~29 tok/s, ~3.3 GB resident, offline with no API key
- [ClawBox Workstation](https://docs.clawbox.com/hardware/clawbox-workstation): DGX Spark model
- [Requirements](https://docs.clawbox.com/hardware/requirements): the shipped on-device model and its measured numbers, plus the Ollama bring-your-own table

## Using ClawBox

- [Chat](https://docs.clawbox.com/guides/chat): two surfaces — the mascot chat panel (provider/model/reasoning pills, hot-applied with no gateway restart) and the full Chat app (no pickers); `/` slash-command autocomplete on both editions, read from the harness's own catalogue (`commands.list` on OpenClaw, `commands.catalog` on Hermes); question / approval / email-approval cards; a failed turn names the provider's reason and says when a fallback model answered; spoken replies OFF by default
- [ClawBox AI](https://docs.clawbox.com/guides/clawbox-ai): device-code pairing, what each plan unlocks, the weekly + 5-hour-burst allowances, credits, and the cloud defaults for speech-out / speech-in / embeddings. ClawBox AI chat renders no model pill on any plan — the plan decides allowance and device features, not a chat model choice
- [Multiple Anthropic Accounts](https://docs.clawbox.com/guides/anthropic-accounts): more than one Claude Pro/Max sign-in or Anthropic API key for coding runs, in the owner's order (preference, never round-robin) under Settings → Providers → Anthropic accounts; a run whose account hits its usage limit (session, weekly, API-key rate limit, no credit) moves to the next account and resumes in the same session; when every account is limited the run waits and the box resumes it by itself at the first reset; credentials only in the encrypted secret store; the agent reads the pool with `anthropic_accounts` (read-only, no emails, no credentials)
- [Memory Shard](https://docs.clawbox.com/guides/memory-shard): the searchable index over notes, conversations and the owner's own folders; both editions (OpenClaw's index is the agent's, on Hermes ClawBox owns it and exposes `memory_shard_search`); needs a Pro or Max plan; cloud vs on-box embedder, and every switch forces a full reindex
- [Local AI](https://docs.clawbox.com/guides/local-ai): Settings → Local AI as a per-model inventory (Gemma 4 ships, Kokoro/Whisper/embeddings install on request); local-only mode (OpenClaw/dual only); nothing heavy is installed by an update
- [Messaging Channels](https://docs.clawbox.com/guides/messaging-channels): Telegram, Discord (token-only connect, invite link built on the box), WhatsApp and email all guided in Settings → Channels; receiving mail is Hermes-only; spoken replies on channels are OpenClaw-only; other OpenClaw channels remain advanced configuration
- [Desktop & Appearance](https://docs.clawbox.com/guides/appearance): wallpapers per edition (Lobster Orbital is the OpenClaw default), the mascot, and the Mascot Pet picker on every edition — the built-in ClawBox crab plus Petdex pets that download on pick
- [Subscriptions](https://docs.clawbox.com/guides/subscriptions): ClawBox AI plans and what each unlocks on the device. Internal tier names are off by one: `flash` = Pro, `pro` = Max
